definitions.gloss: to liven up; to enliven; to boost
definitions.explanation: to make an event, atmosphere, or mood more exciting and energetic

definitions.gloss: to pile up; to heap up

examples.japanese: パーティーを{盛|も}り{上|あ}げよう!
DJが{会場|かいじょう}を{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The DJ got the venue pumped up.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{場|ば}を{盛|も}り{上|あ}げるのが{上手|うま}い。
examples.english: He's good at livening up the atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ご{飯|はん}を{山盛|やまも}りに{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I heaped the rice into a mound.

examples.japanese: みんなで{協力|きょうりょく}してイベントを{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: Everyone worked together to make the event a success.

examples.japanese: {土|つち}を{盛|も}り{上|あ}げて{花壇|かだん}を{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I piled up soil to make a flower bed.

examples.japanese: {皿|さら}にサラダを{高|たか}く{盛|も}り{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I heaped the salad high on the plate.

notes:
{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる is a compound verb combining {盛|も}る (to heap, serve) + {上|あ}げる (to raise).

VERB TYPE:
- Ichidan verb (る-verb)
- Transitive
- Intransitive pair: {盛|も}り{上|あ}がる (to get excited, be in full swing)

SENSE 1 VS SENSE 2:
- Sense 1 (more common): To make something exciting, energetic - used with events, atmosphere
- Sense 2: Physical piling up of objects

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {場|ば}を{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to liven up the atmosphere)
- パーティーを{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to liven up a party)
- {雰囲気|ふんいき}を{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to create an exciting atmosphere)
- イベントを{盛|も}り{上|あ}げる (to make an event exciting)

INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がる: The party/atmosphere itself becomes excited
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}げる: Someone actively makes it exciting

RELATED WORDS:
- {盛|も}り{上|あ}がる (intransitive: to get excited)
- {活気|かっき}づける (to invigorate)
- {高|たか}める (to heighten)

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in casual conversation.
